original_text: - @@INLINE_CODE_B0B9CA22_0000@@ - Jibu hili linaonyesha kuwa ripoti bado hazijapokelewa lakini zinatarajiwa kuja baadaye. Halithibitishi kuwa ripoti zozote tayari zimempokelewa.
